records.speaker: Hodram
records.Japanese:
そこの船、停船せよ。おまえが
ジュリアン・フェルメールだな？
records.current_English:
Heave to!
 You're Julian Vermeer, aren't you?

records.speaker: Julian Vermeer
records.Japanese:
ウイッ、ヒック！
…だったら何だ？
records.current_English: Hic! ...So what?

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
金のために祖国を裏切るという
貴様の行為は、許されるものではない
records.current_English:
You sold out 
 your own country for gold. I won't 
 let that go unpunished.

records.speaker: Julian Vermeer
records.Japanese:
グビグビ…プハーッ！　けっ！
祖国が何だ！　金儲けには関係ねえ！
俺の仕事のジャマしやがると
承知しねえぞ！
records.current_English:
Glug, glug... Ahh! Hah!        
 What's my country
 got to do with making money? 
 Cross me and you'll regret it!

rows: your own country for gold. I won't

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
プレット・ペローだな
ずいぶんと悪事を重ねてきたような
面だ。人殺しを放っておくわけには
いかんのでな…
records.current_English:
Plett Perrault. You look like
 you've committed plenty
 of crimes. I can't leave 
 a murderer at large...

records.speaker: Plett Perrault
records.Japanese:
何だ貴様！？　偉そうに
あんただって生まれて一度も罪を
犯したことがないってこたあ
ねえだろうよ？
records.current_English:
Who do you think you are?
 Don't talk down to me. 
 You've never broken a law
 in your life, have you?

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
やはり、悪事を重ねるしか能がない
男か。では、手加減は無用だな
行くぞ！
records.current_English:
So crime really
 is all you're good at. 
 No reason to hold back, then.
 Here we come!

rows: No reason to hold back, then.

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
ジャン・ラムジオに告ぐ
直ちに不正な交易をやめて降参せよ！
records.current_English:
Jean Ramusio! Cease
 your illegal trading 
 and surrender at once!

records.speaker: Jean Ramusio
records.Japanese:
不正？
へーえ、証拠でもあるのかよ？
records.current_English: Illegal? Oh, really? Got any proof?

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
おまえの存在が証拠そのもの
叩けばホコリの出る身体だろう？
力づくでホコリを出してやっても
構わんぞ
records.current_English:
You're all the proof I need. You 
 reek of dirty dealings. I can shake
 the truth out of you if I have to.

records.speaker: Jean Ramusio
records.Japanese:
物分かりの悪い連中だねえ
そんなに死にたきゃ
手伝ってやるよ！
records.current_English:
You just won't listen, will you? 
 If you're so eager to die, I'll
 be happy to oblige!

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: 捕虜を全員解放しろ
records.current_English: Release all the prisoners.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: くそっ！
records.current_English: Damn!

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
深追いはしてきません
さっさと引き上げていきます
む？
records.current_English:
They're breaking off. Looks like 
 they won't press the chase. Hm?

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese: １隻、座礁しています
records.current_English: A ship ran aground.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
見捨てられたか
中を確認しろ
records.current_English: Abandoned? Check inside.

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese: 提督、ちょっと…
records.current_English: Admiral...

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: どうした？
records.current_English: What?

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
どうもこの船に似つかわしくない
御仁を見つけたのですが
records.current_English:
We found someone who seems 
 out of place on this ship.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.current_English: Hm?

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese: こちらです
records.current_English: Over here.

records.speaker: Speakerless panel
records.Japanese: まるで人形だ……
records.current_English: Like a doll...

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
提督！！
この女！！
records.current_English: Admiral! That woman...!

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
待て、くっ…
俺を海賊か何かと勘違いしている
ようだ
records.current_English:
Wait! Ngh... I think she 
 took me for a pirate or something.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
無理もない
安心しろ、おまえはもう自由だ
records.current_English:
I don't blame you. It's all right. 
 You're free now.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
その顔立ち……
他のアフリカ系民族とは違うようだな？
records.current_English:
Your features... You look different
 from the other Africans here.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
身なりを見れば
イスラム教徒でもなさそうだが…
出自は相当な家柄か
records.current_English:
From your clothes, 
 I'd guess you're not Muslim. Maybe 
 you come from a prominent family.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: …言葉が通じないか
records.current_English: ...We don't speak the same language.

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
どうしますか？　どこから連れて
こられたのかが不明では
送り届けようがありませんが
records.current_English:
What shall we do? We can't take
 her home if we don't know
 where they brought her from.

records.speaker: Manuel Almeida
records.Japanese:
どうします？　どこから連れて
こられたのか分からないんじゃ
送ろうにも困ってしまいますな
records.current_English:
What do we do? We can't take 
 her home without knowing 
 where they took her from.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: 他の捕虜たちの様子は？
records.current_English: What about the other prisoners?

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
みな、このまま
逃がしてほしいようですが
records.current_English:
They all seem to want us to let
 them go here.

records.speaker: Charles Rochefort
records.Japanese:
みんな、このまま
逃がしてほしいようです
records.current_English:
They all seem to want
 to be let go here.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
彼らから見れば、我々も決して
信用できんだろう。分かった
希望者は全員、このまま解放する
records.current_English:
As far as they're concerned, 
 we could be just as bad. 
 All right. Anyone who wants to go
 is free to leave.

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese: 分かりました
records.current_English: Understood.

records.speaker: Charles Rochefort
records.Japanese: 分かりました
records.current_English: Understood.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
おまえも好きなようにするがいい
…そのナイフではこの先、身は守れん
だろう。これをやる
records.current_English:
You can go if you want, too. 
 That knife won't keep you safe 
 out there. Here, take this.

records.speaker: Speakerless panel
records.Japanese:
＜異国の少女＞
！？
records.current_English: Foreign Girl: ?!

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
き、危険です、武器を渡すなど！
また斬りかかるつもりかも
しれませんぞ！
records.current_English:
I-it's dangerous 
 to give her a weapon!
 She might come at you again!

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: 斬りたければ、そうすればいい
records.current_English: If she wants to cut me, let her.

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese: 提督！
records.current_English: Sir!

records.speaker: Speakerless panel
records.Japanese:
＜異国の少女＞
…！
records.current_English: Foreign Girl: ...!

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese: あ、危ない！
records.current_English: Watch out!

records.speaker: Speakerless panel
records.Japanese:
＜異国の少女＞
…
records.current_English: Foreign Girl: ...

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: ん？　いらないのか？
records.current_English: Hm? Don't want it?

records.speaker: Speakerless panel
records.Japanese:
＜異国の少女＞
（こくん。）
records.current_English: Foreign Girl: (Nods.)

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
…
ふっ、そうか
records.current_English: ...Heh. I see.

records.speaker: Manuel Almeida
records.Japanese: （あー、驚いた…。）
records.current_English: (That scared me...)

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.current_English: (Whew...)

rows: I'd guess you're not Muslim. Maybe
you come from a prominent family.
She might come at you again!

records.speaker: Jacob Portunto
records.Japanese:
く、くそっ…
俺の大事な積み荷が…
records.current_English: D-damn... My precious cargo...

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
盗んだ積み荷よりもこれから
カリカットに連行される
自分の立場を案じたらどうだ？
records.current_English:
Never mind the stolen cargo. 
 Worry about yourself. We're
 taking you to Calicut.

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
そろそろ、顔を出してくれても
よさそうなものですが…
records.current_English:
You'd think he'd 
 show himself by now...

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
この調子で、海賊艦隊を
次々に葬り去るぞ
records.current_English:
We'll keep wiping out pirate 
 fleets, one after another.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
…おまえはどうする？
皆と一緒に行かないのか？
records.current_English: ...And you? Won't you go with them?

records.speaker: Speakerless panel
records.Japanese:
＜異国の少女＞
…
records.current_English: Foreign Girl: ...

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
そうか。おまえ１人は
他の捕虜とは違う民族だったな
しばらくはこの街で保護してもらうと
いい
records.current_English:
I see. You aren't
 from the same people 
 as the other captives. The town
 can look after you for a while.

rows: as the other captives. The town
can look after you for a while.

records.speaker: Xien Yan
records.Japanese:
おお、FA殿
リー提督がお呼びです
どうぞ、こちらへ
records.current_English:
Ah, FA! Admiral Li has asked
 to see you. Please, this way.

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese:
とうとうクーンを倒したそうね
おめでとう
records.current_English:
I hear you've finally defeated 
 Kuhn. Congratulations.

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese: どうしたの、浮かない顔して？
records.current_English:
What's wrong? You don't look 
 too pleased.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: 今度は何に利用するつもりだ？
records.current_English: What will you use me for this time?

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese: あら、疑り深い人
records.current_English: My, aren't you suspicious.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
まあ、いい。結果的に俺たちは
東南アジアに足場を築くことが
できた
records.current_English:
Well, let it go. 
 We ended up with a foothold
 in Southeast Asia.

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese:
それは、私たちの利害が
一致してたってこと？
records.current_English:
So you're saying 
 our interests lined up?

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: あるいはな
records.current_English: Perhaps.

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese:
よかった
ついでといっては何だけど
もうひとつ提案があるの
records.current_English:
Good. While we're on the subject,
 I have one more proposal.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: …やはりそうか
records.current_English: ...I thought as much.

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese:
『倭寇』のことは
聞いているかしら
records.current_English: Have you heard of the wako?

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese:
明は鎖国政策をとっているから海軍が
存在しないわ。それにつけこんで大陸の
沿岸を荒らし回り、掠奪を働く日本の
海賊が『倭寇』よ
records.current_English:
The Ming keep their ports closed,
 so they have no navy.
 Japanese pirates take
 advantage of that. 
 They plunder the mainland coast. 
 They're called wako.

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese:
その元締めがソウジン・クルシマ
私が私設艦隊を作ったのも、彼の
襲撃から人々を守るため…
records.current_English:
Their leader is Sojin Kurushima. 
 I formed my private fleet
 to protect people from his raids...

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
そいつを倒してこい、と
言いたいのだな？
records.current_English: You want me to defeat him?

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese:
もちろん、お礼は用意するわ
それに、日本にはきっとあなたの求める
何かがあると思う
records.current_English:
Of course, there'll be a reward. 
 Besides, I think Japan 
 has something you're looking for.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
俺の求める何か？　くっくっくっ
…甘く見られたものだな
俺はおまえの猟犬というわけか
records.current_English:
Something I'm looking for? Heh...
 You take me too lightly. 
 What am I, your hunting dog?

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese:
そういう、うがった見方もあるのね
私は、日本との通商権をあなたに
譲ろうと言っているのに
records.current_English:
That's a cynical way to see it.
 I'm offering 
 you the right to trade with Japan.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: 恩着せがましいことだ
records.current_English: How generous of you.

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese: …やめておく？
records.current_English: ...Would you rather pass?

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
せっかくこんな世界の東端にまで
やって来たのだ。もちろん成果を上げる
つもりだが、ターゲットが日本である
必要はあるまい
records.current_English:
I've come all the way
 to the eastern edge of the world.
 I mean to make something of it.
 But it doesn't have to be Japan.

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese:
…私を相手にしたいって考えなら
それもいいわ
records.current_English:
...If you'd rather take me on, 
 that's fine.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
それが自信なのか、それともハッタリ
なのか非常に興味のあるところだが
俺にはおまえともめる理由は、今の
ところない。そう、いきり立つな
records.current_English:
Confidence or a bluff? 
 I'd love to know. But I have no
 quarrel with you for now.
 No need to get worked up.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
考えるまでもなく、おまえの提案に
乗るのが俺にとって、結局は一番得な
選択になるのは分かっている
records.current_English:
I don't need to think about it.
 Taking your offer is clearly 
 in my best interest.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
まったく恐ろしい女だ…
手のひらで躍るとは、今の俺のような
状態を指すのだろう
records.current_English:
What a formidable woman... Now 
 I know what it feels like
 to dance to someone else's tune.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
いいか。高みの見物でも
決め込むことだ。俺が海賊を一掃する間
手出しは一切必要ない
records.current_English:
Listen. Sit back and watch.
 You won't have to lift a finger
 while I clear out those pirates.

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese: あら、それはどうかしらね？
records.current_English: Oh, will I now?

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
その不敵な笑みが背後に控えていると
思えばこそこんな勇ましい口上も
楽に言える
頼もしい限りだ
records.current_English:
With that fearless smile behind me,
 I can make all the bold speeches 
 I want. How reassuring.

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese: 皮肉な男ね
records.current_English: You and your sarcasm.

records.speaker: Hodram
records.Japanese:
まったくもって素直で扱いやすい男…
心の中のセリフはそんなところだろう
せいぜい朗報を期待するがいいさ
records.current_English:
'So agreeable. So easy to handle.' 
 Isn't that what you're thinking? 
 Just wait for the good news.

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese:
FA提督
見事なお手並みだったわね
records.current_English: Impressive work, Admiral FA.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: …それ以上俺を怒らせるのはよせ
records.current_English: ...Don't make me any angrier.

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese:
それは失礼
では、これが約束のお礼よ
受け取りなさい
records.current_English:
My apologies. Here's 
 the reward I promised. 
 Please take it.

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese:
あなたをこの海域の覇者と認め
なければならない日が訪れたようね
これを受け取りなさい
records.current_English:
Looks like it's time I recognized
 you as master of these waters. 
 Please take this.

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese: FA君
records.current_English: Well, well, FA.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
マリア！？
どうした、こんな所にまで？
records.current_English:
Maria?! What brings you all the way
 out here?

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese:
オスマン帝国海軍が、地中海の制海権を
手中にすべく大攻勢に出たわ
records.current_English:
The Ottoman navy has launched
 a major offensive to seize control 
 of the Mediterranean.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: 何だと！
records.current_English: What?!

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
よもや祖国が戦乱に巻き込まれる
ことはあるまいが…
わざわざ知らせに来てくれたのか？
records.current_English:
I doubt my country will be 
 drawn into the war, but... did you 
 come all this way to warn me?

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese: 恩がないわけでもないしね
records.current_English: Well, I do owe you.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: 助かるよ。礼を言う
records.current_English: I'm glad you did. Thank you.

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese: （あら？　ずいぶん素直…。）
records.current_English:
(Oh? He's
 being awfully straightforward...)

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: だが、『FA君』はやめてくれ…
records.current_English:
Just don't call me 
 'FA' like that...

records.speaker: Speakerless panel
records.Japanese:
エスカンテ軍からの
親書が届きました
records.current_English: A letter came from Escante.

records.speaker: Speakerless panel
records.Japanese:
エスカンテ軍が
宣戦を布告してきました！
records.current_English: Escante's forces have declared war!

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
あの男…
やはり、腹に一物あったな
records.current_English:
That man... I knew he was up 
 to something.

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
結局、我々はエスカンテに
裏切られたわけですな
records.current_English: So Escante betrayed us after all.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
どこかの酒場で、奴らの本性を聞いた
ときから、こうなるとは思っていたが…
我々はかなり不利に陥ったことに
なる
records.current_English:
I saw this coming when I heard 
 what they were really like 
 in a tavern. Still... we're
 at a serious disadvantage now.

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese: と、言いますと？
records.current_English: What do you mean?

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
我が軍がマルドナードと交戦関係に
あった間、エスカンテは金と力を
貯めこんでいたのだ
奴らの目的のために、な
records.current_English:
While we were fighting Maldonado,
 Escante was building up
 his wealth and power.
 He did it for a purpose of his own.

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
目的？
いったいどんな目的なのです？
records.current_English: What purpose? What is he after?

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: まあ、察しはつくが…
records.current_English: Well, I can guess...

rows: I saw this coming when I heard

records.speaker: Speakerless panel
records.Japanese: うぬぬぬ～！
records.current_English: Grrrr!

records.speaker: Diogo Escante
records.Japanese:
あと、あと一歩で私の帝国が…
新世界を手に入れることができたと
いうに…！
き、貴様さえいなければ～！
records.current_English:
I-I was so close. My empire... 
 I could have taken the New World!
 If it weren't for you...!

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: エスカンテ！
records.current_English: Escante!

records.speaker: Diogo Escante
records.Japanese:
貴様にだけは…
私の帝国をくれてやるわけにはいかん！
…死ねえっ！！
records.current_English:
I'll never hand my empire over 
 to you. Anyone but you... Die!

records.speaker: Diogo Escante
records.Japanese:
これはこれは
FA殿
records.current_English: Well, well, FA.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: エスカンテ…
records.current_English: Escante...

records.speaker: Diogo Escante
records.Japanese:
いやあ、お見事
すっかりやられてしまいましたよ
records.current_English:
Well played. You've
 beaten me completely.

records.speaker: Diogo Escante
records.Japanese:
ふっ、ふふふふ
あと、あと一歩で私の帝国が…
新世界を手に入れることができたと
いうのに…
records.current_English:
Heh... Hehehe... I-I was so close. 
 My empire... 
 I could have taken the New World...

records.speaker: Diogo Escante
records.Japanese: き、貴様さえいなければ～！
records.current_English: If it weren't for you...!

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese: 提督、危ないっ！
records.current_English: Admiral, look out!

records.speaker: Diogo Escante
records.Japanese: ぐぼぉおッ！！
records.current_English: Guhhh!!

records.speaker: Diogo Escante
records.Japanese:
ぐ、ぐ、ぐ…
わ、私は、ここで、し、死ぬ…のか？
records.current_English: G-guh... Am I going to die... here?

records.speaker: Diogo Escante
records.Japanese: がはッ！！
records.current_English: Gah!!

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese: 提督、ご無事ですか！　おケガは！？
records.current_English:
Admiral, are you all right?
 Are you hurt?!

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: 大丈夫だ…
records.current_English: I'm all right...

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
エスカンテ…。哀れな男だ
新大陸の民が貴様のような男を
王として認めるなどと、本気で信じて
いたのか…
records.current_English:
Escante... What a pitiful man. 
 Did you really think 
 the people of the New World
 would take you for their king?

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
？　エスカンテが懐に何か
持っています
records.current_English:
Hm? Escante has something tucked 
 inside his clothes.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: あわただしいな…
records.current_English: ...What's all this commotion?

records.speaker: Port Worker
records.Japanese:
海賊ハイレディンが
オスマン帝国海軍にこっぴどくやられた
らしい。敗残兵が引き上げてきて
大変な騒ぎだ
records.current_English:
I hear the Ottoman navy
 thrashed Hayreddin. What's left
 of his pirate fleet is back, 
 and the place is in an uproar.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: ハイレディンが？
records.current_English: Hayreddin lost?

records.speaker: Speakerless panel
records.Japanese: どけ！
records.current_English: Move!

records.speaker: Port Worker
records.Japanese:
ああっ！！
ハ、ハイレディン……様！！
records.current_English: Ah!! H-Hayreddin!

records.speaker: Barbarossa Hayreddin
records.Japanese:
何だ。この俺の醜態を
笑いに来たか？
records.current_English: What? Come to laugh at my disgrace?

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
…自意識過剰な男だ
俺は国王の命により、オスマン帝国と
一戦交えに来たのだ
records.current_English:
...You think 
 everything's about you. I'm here 
 on the king's orders to fight
 the Ottoman Empire.

records.speaker: Barbarossa
records.Japanese:
ふっ、そいつは災難だな
奴らを敵にまわすなら
死ぬ覚悟が必要だ
records.current_English:
Heh. Bad luck for you. 
 If you cross them, be ready to die.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
たしかハイレディン一家は
オスマン帝国と同盟関係に
あったはずだが？
records.current_English:
Wasn't your fleet allied 
 with the Ottoman Empire?

records.speaker: Barbarossa Hayreddin
records.Japanese:
オスマン海軍総司令のパシャが、今回の
攻勢に俺たち海賊艦隊を組み込もうと
同盟中の俺に“臣下の礼”をとるよう
強要してきたのだ
records.current_English:
Pasha commands the Ottoman navy. He
 wanted our fleet in his offensive. 
 We were allies, but he demanded
 I bow to him as his vassal.

records.speaker: Barbarossa Hayreddin
records.Japanese:
親父と俺が苦労して作り上げた艦隊が
軍隊なぞに組み込まれるのはごめんだ
俺は迷うことなくオスマン帝国に
反旗をひるがえした…
records.current_English:
My father and I worked hard
 to build that fleet. 
 I wouldn't turn it over
 to the military. 
 I rose against the Ottomans
 without hesitation...

records.speaker: Barbarossa Hayreddin
records.Japanese:
ここまではよかった。劣勢とはいえ
２年や３年はしのいで、アルジェ海賊の
誇りを見せてやるつもりだった
records.current_English:
It went well at first. They had
 the upper hand. I meant to hold out
 two or three years and show them 
 the pride of Algiers' pirates.

records.speaker: Barbarossa Hayreddin
records.Japanese:
ところが、信頼していた配下に裏切られ
パシャ軍に不意を突かれてこの有様だ
まったく…親父に会わせる顔がない
records.current_English:
Someone I trusted in my own crew 
 betrayed me. Pasha's forces took us
 by surprise. Look at me now. Damn
 it... How can I face my father?

records.speaker: Barbarossa Hayreddin
records.Japanese:
おまえにこんな話をしても
しかたがないな
records.current_English: No point telling you this.

records.speaker: Barbarossa Hayreddin
records.Japanese:
こいつをくれてやる。パシャの野郎が
臣下の証として送ってきた物だ
見るのもいまいましい！
records.current_English:
Here, take it. That bastard Pasha
 sent it to mark me as his vassal.
 I can't stand the sight of it!

records.speaker: Barbarossa Hayreddin
records.Japanese: いいか。せいぜい、無様な負け方はせんことだ
records.current_English:
If you lose, at least try
 not to embarrass yourself.

rows: on the king's orders to fight

records.speaker: Charles Rochefort
records.Japanese: ん、何々？
records.current_English: Hm? What's this?

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
何の張り紙だ？
…ほう、闘牛か！
records.current_English:
What's that poster for? ...Ah, 
 a bullfight!

records.speaker: Charles Rochefort
records.Japanese: せっかくの機会だ、見に行きますか
records.current_English:
We've got the chance.
 Want to go see it?

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: …ふぅ。えらい人の数だな
records.current_English: Whew. What a crowd.

records.speaker: Charles Rochefort
records.Japanese: ものすごい活気ですね
records.current_English: It's so lively!

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
スペイン王国は今のところ
世界を制しておるからな
records.current_English: Spain rules much of the world now.

records.speaker: Charles Rochefort
records.Japanese:
張り紙によれば
今日は一番人気の闘牛士が
出るそうですよ
records.current_English:
The poster says
 their most popular bullfighter 
 is up today.

records.speaker: Patron
records.Japanese: わっはっは！
records.current_English: Ha ha ha!

records.speaker: Port Worker
records.Japanese: 今日も笑わせてくれよー！
records.current_English: Make us laugh again!

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: あれが一番の人気闘牛士なのか？
records.current_English: That's the most popular bullfighter?

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese: あれは副闘牛士（ピカドール）ですな
records.current_English: That's a picador.

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
あのように、事前に牛の体力を奪い
主役の闘牛士（マタドール）が
トドメを刺すのです
records.current_English:
He wears the bull down beforehand. 
 Then the matador,
 the main attraction, delivers
 the finishing blow.

records.speaker: Emilio Ferog
records.Japanese: とりゃああーーっ！！
records.current_English: Hyaaah!!

records.speaker: Patron
records.Japanese:
がはははは！
あのバカ、牛と遊んでやがる！
うひょー！　投げ飛ばしやがった！
records.current_English:
Ha ha ha! Look at that fool
 playing with the bull! Whoa! 
 He threw it!

records.speaker: Emilio Ferog
records.Japanese: むんがーーっ！！
records.current_English: Raaah!!

records.speaker: Patron
records.Japanese: わっはっは！
records.current_English: Ha ha ha!

records.speaker: Shopkeeper
records.Japanese: 早く引っこめーっ！！
records.current_English: Get out of the ring already!

records.speaker: Trader
records.Japanese: おおっ、いよいよ真打ちの登場だ！
records.current_English: Here he comes! The star of the show!

records.speaker: Guildmaster
records.Japanese: おおーっ！！
records.current_English: Yeaaah!!

records.speaker: Patron
records.Japanese: 待ってました！
records.current_English: At last!

records.speaker: Port Worker
records.Japanese: ひゅーひゅー！
records.current_English: Woo-hoo!

records.speaker: Shopkeeper
records.Japanese: わーわー！
records.current_English: Hooray!

records.speaker: Trader
records.Japanese: 楽しませてくれよ！
records.current_English: Give us a show!

records.speaker: Patron
records.Japanese: ブラーボー！！
records.current_English: Bravo!!

records.speaker: Port Worker
records.Japanese: わーわー！
records.current_English: Hooray!

records.speaker: Speakerless panel
records.Japanese: ざわざわ…
records.current_English: Murmur...

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: …誘ってみるか
records.current_English: ...I think I'll ask him to join us.

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese: 本気ですか？
records.current_English: Seriously?

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: 得難い人材だ
records.current_English: Talent like that is hard to find.

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese: …？　闘牛士が役に立ちますか？
records.current_English:
Would a bullfighter really 
 be of any use to us?

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: ああ
records.current_English: Yes.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: ちょっといいか？
records.current_English: Got a moment?

records.speaker: Emilio Ferog
records.Japanese: んー？
records.current_English: Hm?

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
ええっ！？
……そ、そっちのほう…
records.current_English: What?! ...You mean him?

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
おまえ、船で大海原に
乗り出す気はないか？
records.current_English: Want to sail the open sea?

records.speaker: Emilio Ferog
records.Japanese:
ふね？　ふねかあ。こわそうだなぁ
おいしそうじゃあないしなあ
records.current_English:
A ship? That sounds scary. Doesn't 
 sound very tasty, either.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
まあ、船はうまくないな
だが、船に乗って旅をすれば
世界中のごちそうにありつけるぞ
records.current_English:
No, the ship won't taste good. 
 But sail with us 
 and you can feast on good food 
 from all over the world.

records.speaker: Emilio Ferog
records.Japanese: ご、ごちそう？　へへっ。へへへ
records.current_English: D-delicious food? Heh. Hehehe...

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
そうだ。世界にはいろいろな
食べ物がある
records.current_English:
That's right. There
 are all kinds of food out there.

records.speaker: Emilio Ferog
records.Japanese:
そ、そおかあ。いろいろが
いっぱいかあ。じゃあいくよお！
うみでもどこでも！
records.current_English:
R-really? All kinds of food? Then
 I'll go! To sea, anywhere!

records.speaker: Hodram
records.Japanese:
決まりだな。それでは
名前を教えてもらおうか。俺は
FI・FA
records.current_English:
Settled, then. Your name?
 I'm FI FA.

records.speaker: Emilio Ferog
records.Japanese: お、おいら、エミリオ・フェローグ
records.current_English: M-my name's Emilio Ferog.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: エミリオ、歓迎するぞ
records.current_English: Welcome, Emilio.

rows: are all kinds of food out there.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese: 唐突なんですが
records.current_English: This is rather sudden, but...

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.current_English: Hm?

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
あの…
私を雇っていただけませんか？
records.current_English: Would you hire me?

records.speaker: Hodram
records.Japanese:
入隊志願者か。腕に覚えがあるなら
考えてやってもいいぞ
records.current_English:
Looking to enlist? 
 If you've got the skills,
 I'll consider it.

records.speaker: Janus
records.Japanese:
はい。機械が好きなので
船の扱いや修理なんかが得意です
records.current_English:
Yes. I like machinery. 
 I'm good with ships, 
 and I can fix them, too.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: 条件は？
records.current_English: What are your terms?

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
…では、お願いがあります
私に金貨１０００枚ゆずってください！
records.current_English:
...Then I have one favor to ask. 
 Could you give me 1,000 gold?

records.speaker: Player choice
records.Japanese: いいだろう
records.current_English: Agreed.

records.speaker: Player choice
records.Japanese: そんな金はない
records.current_English: I don't have that much money.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
ありがとうございます！
これで修理できるぞ！
records.current_English:
Thank you! Now I can get 
 it repaired!

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
…と、すみません
１日だけ出航を待ってください
records.current_English:
Oh, sorry. Could you 
 hold off sailing for just one day?

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese: それでは。明日、出港所で！
records.current_English:
I'll see you at the port office
 tomorrow!

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
いやー、お待ちしていましたよ
さあ、こちらです。見てください
records.current_English:
Ah, I've been waiting for you! 
 This way. Take a look.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
昨日いただいた修理費のおかげで
船の修繕も終わり
借金も返してきたところです
records.current_English:
Thanks to the
 money you gave me yesterday, 
 the ship's repaired
 and my debts are paid.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
すみません、試すようなことをして
しまいました。やっぱり自分の命を
預ける提督は、それなりの器量を
備えてていただかないとね
records.current_English:
Sorry for testing you like that. 
 If I'm putting my life 
 in an admiral's hands, I want
 to know what they're made of.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
あなたなら安心です
よかったらこの船、使ってください
records.current_English:
I know I can trust you. Please, use
 this ship if you'd like.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: ふむ。名を聞こうか
records.current_English: Your name?

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
この船ですか？
もちろん、好きな名前を付けて
くださって結構ですよ
records.current_English:
The ship's name? You're welcome
 to call it whatever you like.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
いや、船の名ではない…
まだ君の名を聞いていないのだが？
records.current_English:
I meant yours. You still haven't 
 told me your name.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
あ、すみません
昨日はつい浮かれちゃって
まだ名乗っていませんでしたね
records.current_English:
Oh, sorry! I got so excited
 yesterday that I forgot
 to introduce myself.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
ジェナス・パサーです
これからも、よろしくお願いします
records.current_English:
I'm Janus Pasar. I look forward
 to sailing with you.

records.speaker: Speakerless panel
records.Japanese:
ドックから船を引き出して
『改造』で好きな名前を付けてください
records.current_English:
Take the ship out of the dock, then
 choose Refit to give it any name 
 you like.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
そうですか…。仕方ありませんね
ほかを当たることにします
records.current_English:
I see... Well, it can't be helped. 
 I'll try someone else.

rows: hold off sailing for just one day?

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese: おお、これが『新羅の金冠』……
records.current_English:
Ah, so this is the 
 Silla Gold Crown...

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: 重厚なだけでなく気品が感じられる…
records.current_English: It's imposing... but graceful, too.

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
女性でなくても欲しがる気持ちは
分かりますな
records.current_English:
You don't have to be a woman to see
 why someone would want it.

records.speaker: Julian Lopes
records.Japanese: あ！　そ、その手に持っているのは…
records.current_English: Ah! Th-that thing in your hand...

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
おまえ…ユリアン、だったか
先に出ていながら
一足遅かったようだな
records.current_English:
You... Julian, was it? 
 You had a head start, but it looks 
 like you got here a little late.

records.speaker: Julian Lopes
records.Japanese:
あなたは？
ぼく、どこかでお会いしました？
records.current_English: Who are you? Have we met?

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
俺はFI
おまえが杭州の酒場で『新羅の金冠』の
ことを話しているのを聞いていたのだ
records.current_English:
I'm FI. I heard you 
 talking about the Silla Gold Crown 
 at the tavern in Hangzhou.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
その話に興味を引かれて、俺も
『新羅の金冠』を探しにここまで
やって来たというわけだ
records.current_English:
You piqued my interest. I came 
 all this way to look 
 for the Silla Gold Crown myself.

records.speaker: Julian Lopes
records.Japanese:
ひ、ひどい…
ぼくが彼女にプレゼントするはずの
ものだったのに…
records.current_English:
Th-that's not fair...
 I meant to give it to her.

records.speaker: Julian Lopes
records.Japanese:
これじゃ、ぼくの面目が丸つぶれだよ！
ああ、もう美華に合わせる顔がない…
お願いだ、それを譲ってくれませんか？
records.current_English:
I'll look like a fool! 
 How can I face Mihwa now?
 Please, could you let me have it?

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese: …どういたしますか？
records.current_English: What will you do?

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: …いいだろう
records.current_English: Very well.

records.speaker: Julian Lopes
records.Japanese: ホントですか！
records.current_English: Really?

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
ああ、持っていけ。…我々は海の男だ
使い道もないし、宝の持ち腐れだ
自分で見つけたことにして
構わんぞ
records.current_English:
Take it. We're sailors.
 We've no use for it, and I'd 
 hate to see it gather dust.
 You can say you found it yourself.

records.speaker: Julian Lopes
records.Japanese:
ああ、なんて素晴らしい人だ！
いつか、きっとお礼をしますから！
じゃあ！
records.current_English:
Oh, you're wonderful! I'll repay 
 your kindness someday, 
 I promise! Goodbye!

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
素晴らしいのは当然だ
このお方はFOの…
records.current_English:
Of course he is! This gentleman
 is the FO's...

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
もう、行ってしまったぞ
会う機会があれば
ゆっくり話してみたい気もするな
records.current_English:
He's gone already. I'd like
 a chance to sit down and talk
 if we run into him again.

records.speaker: Sailor
records.Japanese: そこの艦長さん
records.current_English: Hey, Captain!

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: 俺のことか？
records.current_English: Me?

records.speaker: Sailor
records.Japanese:
そうだよ、あんただよ
あんたは奇跡ってやつを信じるかい
records.current_English:
That's right, you. Do you believe
 in miracles?

records.speaker: Player choice
records.Japanese: 信じる
records.current_English: I do.

records.speaker: Player choice
records.Japanese: 信じない
records.current_English: I don't.

records.speaker: Sailor
records.Japanese:
へええ？奇跡なんぞを信じるとは
今どき珍しいね
艦長さんにしちゃ、頼りないみたいだな
records.current_English:
Really? You don't meet many people 
 who believe in miracles
 these days. You don't sound
 too steady for a captain.

records.speaker: Fernando Dias
records.Japanese:
てめえ、うちの提督に向かって
何を言いやがる
records.current_English:
Watch your mouth!
 That's our admiral!

records.speaker: Sailor
records.Japanese: ふん。違うってのかい？
records.current_English: Hmph. Am I wrong?

records.speaker: Fernando Dias
records.Japanese: てめえ！
records.current_English: You!

records.speaker: Sailor
records.Japanese:
だが、奇跡を信じねえで
難破するようなヤツもいるんだ！
それよりは、ずっとマシってもんだ！
records.current_English:
Some people doubt miracles 
 and still get shipwrecked! You're
 better off than that!

records.speaker: Fernando Dias
records.Japanese: えっ？
records.current_English: Huh?

records.speaker: Sailor
records.Japanese:
すまん。つい怒鳴っちまった
その艦長さんを悪く言うつもりは
なかったんだ
records.current_English:
Sorry. I got carried away
 and yelled. I didn't mean to insult
 your captain.

records.speaker: Fernando Dias
records.Japanese: よく分からねえヤツだなあ…
records.current_English: What a strange one...

records.speaker: Sailor
records.Japanese:
実は、奇跡を信じてる艦長さんに
これを持ってもらいたくてね
records.current_English:
The truth is, I wanted a captain 
 who believes in miracles 
 to have this.

records.speaker: Sailor
records.Japanese:
ここで、船が着くたびに
こうして声を掛けていたんだ
あんたたちでちょうど１００人目だ
records.current_English:
I ask whenever a ship comes in.
 You're the hundredth.

records.speaker: Fernando Dias
records.Japanese: これは？
records.current_English: What is it?

records.speaker: Sailor
records.Japanese:
奇跡を呼ぶという
弾丸のペンダントさ
records.current_English:
A Miracle Bullet Charm.
 They say it works miracles.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
そんな貴重なものを
俺に渡すというのか？
records.current_English:
You're giving me 
 something this valuable?

records.speaker: Sailor
records.Japanese:
ああ、あんたみたいな人にもらって
欲しいのさ。こいつは、俺のお守り
だったんだが…
俺はもう船に乗れない体なんだよ
records.current_English:
Yeah. I want someone like you
 to have it. It was my lucky charm, 
 but... I'm in no shape to
 sail anymore.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: そうか、それならありがたくいただこう
records.current_English:
I see. In that case, I'll take it. 
 Thank you.

records.speaker: Speakerless panel
records.Japanese:
FIの運勢が
１上がりました！
records.current_English: FI's Luck rose by 1!

records.speaker: Speakerless panel
records.Japanese:
フェルナンドの運勢が
１上がりました！
records.current_English: Fernando's Luck rose by 1!

records.speaker: Fernando Dias
records.Japanese:
変なのに関わると運が落ちちまうぜ
とっとと行きましょう
records.current_English:
Stick around an oddball like 
 that and you'll have bad luck. 
 Let's get moving.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: ああ
records.current_English: Yes.

records.speaker: Speakerless panel
records.Japanese:
FIの精神が
１上がりました！
records.current_English: FI's Spirit rose by 1!

records.speaker: Speakerless panel
records.Japanese:
フェルナンドの精神が
１上がりました！
records.current_English: Fernando's Spirit rose by 1!

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
！
ここは…
records.current_English: Ah! This place...

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: どうしたんだ、ゲルハルト
records.current_English: What is it, Gerhard?

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
いえ
ちょっと昔を思い出しまして…
records.current_English:
It just brought back 
 an old memory...

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: ん？
records.current_English: Hm?

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
かつて、この辺りで敵の海賊と
戦った際、帯剣を失いましてな
records.current_English:
I lost my sword fighting pirates 
 near here once.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: ほう…剣？
records.current_English: A sword?

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
ええ。ただの古びたカッツバルケル
なのですが、見かけからは想像できぬ
ほど使い心地がよくて
長年愛用しておったのです
records.current_English:
Just an old Katzbalger, but it 
 handled far better than it looked. 
 I carried it for years 
 and grew quite fond of it.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
…それは残念だったな
見つからなかったのか？
records.current_English: That's a shame. You never found it?

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
どこにもありませんでした…
きっと、付近の漁民にでも拾われて
二束三文で売られてしまったの
でしょう
records.current_English:
I looked everywhere... One 
 of the local fishers probably found
 it and sold it for next to nothing.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
そうかな。見る目のある者が拾って
大事に使っているかもしれんぞ
records.current_English:
Maybe someone who
 knows a good sword found 
 it and is taking care of it.

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
…あれほどの剣には、めったに
巡り会えません。価値の分かる人物が
使ってくれているなら
少しは気が楽なのですが…
records.current_English:
You rarely come across 
 a blade like that. 
 It would ease my mind to know it's 
 with someone who appreciates it.
